blocks.zh: Chapter 7: Electrical Services / 電氣服務
blocks.en: Chapter 7: Electrical Services

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the GMP requirements for electrical equipment in cleanroom environments of different classifications (ISO 5 through ISO 8) / 了解不同潔淨室等級（ISO 5 至 ISO 8）中電氣設備的 GMP 要求
blocks.en: Understand the GMP requirements for electrical equipment in cleanroom environments of different classifications (ISO 5 through ISO 8)

blocks.zh: Recognize the importance of UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) and emergency power for critical control systems / 認識不斷電系統（UPS）與緊急電力對關鍵控制系統的重要性
blocks.en: Recognize the importance of UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) and emergency power for critical control systems

blocks.zh: Learn the design principles for cleanroom lighting: flush-mount fixtures, non-shedding materials, and airflow compatibility / 學習潔淨室照明設計原則：嵌入式燈具、不脫落材質、與氣流的相容性
blocks.en: Learn the design principles for cleanroom lighting: flush-mount fixtures, non-shedding materials, and airflow compatibility

blocks.zh: Understand door interlock systems for airlocks and their role in maintaining pressure cascades / 了解氣閘門連鎖系統及其在維持壓差級聯中的角色
blocks.en: Understand door interlock systems for airlocks and their role in maintaining pressure cascades

blocks.zh: Grasp wiring principles: minimizing wall penetrations, sealing conduits, and preventing contamination pathways / 掌握配線原則：最小化穿牆孔、密封管線、防止污染路徑
blocks.en: Grasp wiring principles: minimizing wall penetrations, sealing conduits, and preventing contamination pathways

blocks.zh: Know when and why hazardous (ATEX) electrical classifications apply in sterile facilities / 了解在無菌設施中何時及為何需要防爆電氣分類
blocks.en: Know when and why hazardous (ATEX) electrical classifications apply in sterile facilities

blocks.zh: 7.1 Introduction 7.1 簡介
blocks.en: 7.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析
blocks.en: Instructor Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念
blocks.en: Core Concept

blocks.zh: 電氣服務的 GMP 角色：在無菌製造設施中，電氣系統通常不直接影響產品品質或患者安全。然而，電氣設備的設計與安裝方式會影響潔淨室的可清潔性、密封完整性以及壓差維持能力。
blocks.en: The GMP role of electrical services: In a sterile manufacturing facility, the electrical system does not usually have a direct impact on product quality or patient safety. However, how electrical equipment is designed and installed affects cleanroom cleanability, seal integrity, and the ability to maintain pressure differentials.

blocks.zh: 本章的核心問題是：電氣設備如何在不破壞潔淨室完整性的前提下提供必要功能？
blocks.en: The central question of this chapter is: how can electrical equipment provide the necessary functions without compromising cleanroom integrity?

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 手術室的電源插座：想像醫院的手術室 — 你不能隨意在牆上打洞來拉電線，每個插座和開關都必須嵌入式安裝、可清潔消毒、不能有任何藏污納垢的縫隙。潔淨室的電氣設計邏輯完全相同：功能要有，但不能犧牲環境品質。
blocks.en: Power outlets in an operating room: Picture a hospital operating room. You cannot simply drill holes in the wall to run wires; every outlet and switch must be flush-mounted, cleanable and disinfectable, with no gaps where dirt can collect. Cleanroom electrical design follows exactly the same logic: the function must be there, but never at the expense of environmental quality.

blocks.zh: 7.2 General Requirements 7.2 一般要求
blocks.en: 7.2 General Requirements

blocks.zh: 核心概念：電氣設備的 GMP 五大要求
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Five GMP Requirements for Electrical Equipment

blocks.zh: 所有安裝在無菌區域的電氣設備必須滿足五個基本要求：
blocks.en: All electrical equipment installed in sterile areas must meet five basic requirements:

blocks.zh: 可清潔（Cleanable） — 表面平滑，可使用標準清潔劑擦拭
blocks.en: Cleanable - smooth surfaces that can be wiped down with standard cleaning agents

blocks.zh: 無凸緣與縫隙（Ledge & Crevice Free） — 不能有微生物或微粒積聚的死角
blocks.en: Ledge & Crevice Free - no dead spots where microorganisms or particles can accumulate

blocks.zh: 不脫落（Non-shedding） — 材質不會釋放微粒到環境中
blocks.en: Non-shedding - materials that do not release particles into the environment

blocks.zh: 密封（Sealed） — 防止空氣洩漏影響壓差，並阻止外部污染進入
blocks.en: Sealed - prevents air leakage that would affect pressure differentials and stops external contamination from entering

blocks.zh: 與消毒劑相容（Compatible with Sanitization Agents） — 能承受 VHP、過氧化氫、酒精等消毒劑
blocks.en: Compatible with Sanitization Agents - able to withstand sanitizing agents such as VHP, hydrogen peroxide and alcohol

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「密封」的不同等級
blocks.en: Key Point: Different Levels of "Sealed"

blocks.zh: 原文特別區分了不同等級的「密封」含義：
blocks.en: The source text distinguishes between different levels of what "sealed" means:

blocks.zh: ISO 5/Grade A — 氣密封（Hermetically Sealed）：完全不透氣，確保單向氣流不受干擾
blocks.en: ISO 5/Grade A - Hermetically Sealed: completely airtight, ensuring that unidirectional airflow is not disturbed

blocks.zh: ISO 8/Grade C — 高度防護（High Protection against Ingress）：防水防塵，相當於 IP65 等級以上
blocks.en: ISO 8/Grade C - High Protection against Ingress: protected against water and dust, equivalent to IP65 or higher

blocks.zh: 這個區別在實務上非常重要 — ISO 5 區域內的每個電氣元件都必須視為潔淨室外殼的一部分。
blocks.en: This distinction is very important in practice: every electrical component inside an ISO 5 area must be treated as part of the cleanroom envelope.

blocks.zh: 潛水艇 vs 雨衣：ISO 5 的電氣密封要求就像潛水艇 — 絕對氣密，任何微小的洩漏都不能接受。ISO 8 的密封要求則像一件好的雨衣 — 能擋住水和灰塵，但不需要像潛水艇一樣承受壓力差。
blocks.en: Submarine vs. raincoat: The electrical sealing requirement for ISO 5 is like a submarine: absolutely airtight, with no tolerance for even the smallest leak. The requirement for ISO 8 is more like a good raincoat: it keeps out water and dust, but does not need to withstand a pressure difference the way a submarine does.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：最小化原則
blocks.en: Key Point: The Principle of Minimization

blocks.zh: ISO 5 區域的「減法思維」：在最高等級的潔淨室中，設計原則不是「如何安裝電氣設備」，而是「如何避免安裝電氣設備」。能放在外面的就放在外面 — 燈的開關放走廊、配電盤放機房、感測器盡可能遠端安裝。
blocks.en: "Subtractive thinking" in ISO 5 areas: In the highest-grade cleanrooms, the design question is not "how do we install the electrical equipment?" but "how do we avoid installing electrical equipment at all?" Whatever can be placed outside should be placed outside: light switches in the corridor, distribution panels in the plant room, and sensors mounted remotely wherever possible.

blocks.zh: 這是 GMP 電氣設計中最常被忽略的原則。許多工程師習慣在需要的地方安裝設備，而不是先問「能不能把這個東西搬到外面去？」
blocks.en: This is the most frequently overlooked principle in GMP electrical design. Many engineers are used to installing equipment where it is needed, instead of first asking, "Can this be moved outside?"

blocks.zh: 實務應用
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: GEP 原則：電氣系統雖然不直接影響產品品質，但影響業務連續性。根據 GEP（Good Engineering Practice），設計時需考慮：冗餘供電、緊急發電機、UPS 保護等。停電造成的生產批次損失可能高達數百萬元。
blocks.en: GEP principles: Although the electrical system does not directly affect product quality, it does affect business continuity. Under GEP (Good Engineering Practice), the design should consider redundant power supply, emergency generators, UPS protection and so on. The loss of production batches caused by a power failure can run into millions.

blocks.zh: 7.3 Control System Power 7.3 控制系統電源
blocks.en: 7.3 Control System Power

blocks.zh: 核心概念：控制系統電力
blocks.en: Core Concept: Control System Power

blocks.zh: UPS（不斷電系統）：現代無菌設施大量依賴數位控制系統（BMS、SCADA、PLC）。這些控制器對電力中斷極為敏感 — 即使短暫的電力閃斷也可能導致：
blocks.en: UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply): Modern sterile facilities rely heavily on digital control systems (BMS, SCADA, PLC). These controllers are extremely sensitive to power interruptions; even a brief power flicker can cause:

blocks.zh: 控制程式遺失或重置
blocks.en: Loss or reset of control programs

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統失去控制，房間壓差崩潰
blocks.en: Loss of HVAC control, with room pressure differentials collapsing

blocks.zh: 製程參數記錄中斷，造成 GMP 數據完整性問題
blocks.en: Interruption of process parameter records, creating GMP data integrity issues

blocks.zh: 因此，關鍵控制系統必須由 UPS 供電，確保斷電時仍能執行有序關機（Orderly Shutdown）或維持監控。
blocks.en: Critical control systems must therefore be powered by a UPS, so that an Orderly Shutdown can be carried out, or monitoring maintained, when power is lost.

blocks.zh: 電腦突然關機 vs 正常關機：想像你正在電腦上做一份重要的報告，突然停電 — 所有未存檔的工作全部遺失。UPS 就是給你的電腦裝一個大電池，讓你在停電後有足夠時間儲存檔案並正常關機。在無菌設施中，這個「未存檔的工作」可能是一個價值百萬的生產批次。
blocks.en: Abrupt computer shutdown vs. orderly shutdown: Imagine you are working on an important report on your computer when the power suddenly fails, and all unsaved work is lost. A UPS is like fitting your computer with a big battery, giving you enough time after the outage to save your files and shut down properly. In a sterile facility, that "unsaved work" could be a production batch worth millions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：同時重啟的風險
blocks.en: Key Point: The Risk of Simultaneous Restart

blocks.zh: 跳閘保護（Breaker Trip Prevention）：停電恢復後，如果所有設備同時啟動，瞬間湧入電流（Inrush Current）可能超過主斷路器容量，導致再次跳閘。系統必須程式化為依序啟動（Staggered Restart），避免這種「二次災難」。
blocks.en: Breaker Trip Prevention: When power is restored, if all equipment starts at the same moment, the inrush current may exceed the capacity of the main breaker and trip it again. The system must be programmed for Staggered Restart to avoid this "second disaster".

blocks.zh: 這在 CDMO 工廠尤其重要 — 多條生產線的 HVAC、冷水機組、充填設備同時啟動的衝擊電流可能是正常運行的 5-8 倍。
blocks.en: This is especially important in CDMO plants: when the HVAC, chillers and filling equipment of several production lines start at the same time, the inrush current can be 5 to 8 times that of normal operation.

blocks.zh: 7.4 Power Distribution 7.4 配電
blocks.en: 7.4 Power Distribution

blocks.zh: 核心概念：配電系統的雙重要求
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Two Requirements of the Distribution System

blocks.zh: 配電系統必須同時滿足兩個面向：
blocks.en: The distribution system must satisfy two aspects at the same time:

blocks.zh: 可靠性（Reliability） — 電力不中斷，保證生產連續性
blocks.en: Reliability - uninterrupted power, ensuring production continuity

blocks.zh: 穩定性（Stability） — 電壓、頻率穩定，不出現突波或驟降
blocks.en: Stability - stable voltage and frequency, with no surges or dips

blocks.zh: 壓差監控（DP Monitoring）的特殊地位：原文特別強調差壓監控的電力供應是「關鍵議題」。因為潔淨室的壓差級聯是防止交叉污染的核心屏障 — 如果停電後既失去壓差、又無法監控壓差，就無法證明產品在停電期間未受污染。
blocks.en: The special status of DP monitoring: The source text specifically stresses that the power supply to differential pressure monitoring is a "critical issue". The cleanroom pressure cascade is the core barrier against cross-contamination; if a power failure causes the loss of both the pressure differential and the ability to monitor it, there is no way to demonstrate that the product was not contaminated during the outage.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：HVAC 風扇慣性
blocks.en: Key Point: HVAC Fan Inertia

blocks.zh: 風扇旋轉續行（Fan Rotation Continue）：短暫停電後，HVAC 風扇的慣性可以讓氣流繼續運行數秒。如果設計得當，這段時間足以維持房間壓差在可接受範圍內。這就是為什麼原文說「impact could be mediated」— 不是所有短暫停電都會導致壓差崩潰。
blocks.en: Fan Rotation Continue: After a brief power loss, the inertia of the HVAC fans can keep air moving for a few seconds. If properly designed, this time may be enough to keep room pressure differentials within an acceptable range. This is why the source text says "impact could be mediated": not every brief power failure causes the pressure differential to collapse.

blocks.zh: 但這需要經過風險評估來確認：停電多長時間壓差仍可接受？這通常是確效（Qualification）過程中需要測試的項目。
blocks.en: However, this must be confirmed through risk assessment: for how long can power be lost before the pressure differential is no longer acceptable? This is usually something to be tested during qualification.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 7.5 Lighting 7.5 照明
blocks.en: 7.5 Lighting

blocks.zh: 核心概念：潔淨室照明設計原則
blocks.en: Core Concept: Cleanroom Lighting Design Principles

blocks.zh: 潔淨室照明設計必須平衡三個目標：
blocks.en: Cleanroom lighting design must balance three objectives:

blocks.zh: 足夠亮度 — 最低 500 lux（工作區域），確保人員操作安全與準確
blocks.en: Sufficient brightness - at least 500 lux in work areas, ensuring safe and accurate operation by personnel

blocks.zh: 不破壞潔淨度 — 燈具本身不能成為微粒或微生物的污染源
blocks.en: No loss of cleanliness - the fixtures themselves must not become a source of particles or microorganisms

blocks.zh: 不干擾氣流 — 特別在 ISO 5 單向氣流區域，表面安裝燈具會擾亂層流
blocks.en: No airflow disruption - especially in ISO 5 unidirectional airflow areas, where surface-mounted fixtures disturb laminar flow

blocks.zh: 核心概念：嵌入式 vs 表面式燈具
blocks.en: Core Concept: Recessed vs. Surface-Mounted Fixtures

blocks.zh: 嵌入式燈具（Recess Mounted / Flush-Mount Fixture）：
blocks.en: Recess Mounted / Flush-Mount Fixture:

blocks.zh: 燈具嵌入天花板，表面與天花板齊平
blocks.en: The fixture is recessed into the ceiling, with its surface flush with the ceiling

blocks.zh: 不產生凸出面，不干擾氣流
blocks.en: It creates no protruding surfaces and does not disturb airflow

blocks.zh: 維護可從天花板上方的技術夾層進行，不進入潔淨室
blocks.en: Maintenance can be carried out from the technical void above the ceiling, without entering the cleanroom

blocks.zh: ISO 5 和 ISO 7 區域的首選方案
blocks.en: The preferred solution for ISO 5 and ISO 7 areas

blocks.zh: 淚滴式燈具（Teardrop Fixture）：
blocks.en: Teardrop Fixture:

blocks.zh: 流線型設計，減少對氣流的干擾
blocks.en: Streamlined design that reduces disturbance to airflow

blocks.zh: 適用於 ISO 5 區域中無法嵌入安裝的位置
blocks.en: Suitable for positions in ISO 5 areas where recessed installation is not possible

blocks.zh: 天花板是寸土寸金的「不動產」：潔淨室的天花板空間就像市中心的房地產 — HVAC 出風口、回風口、HEPA 過濾器、製程設備接口、燈具、消防噴頭全部都要搶這塊空間。原文提醒我們，HVAC 優先權最高，照明只能「見縫插針」。因此，設計階段就必須做好天花板服務的協調規劃。
blocks.en: Ceiling space is prime "real estate": Cleanroom ceiling space is like property in the city center: HVAC supply outlets, return grilles, HEPA filters, process equipment interfaces, light fixtures and fire sprinklers all compete for it. The source text reminds us that HVAC has the highest priority and lighting can only be fitted into whatever room is left. Coordinated planning of ceiling services must therefore be done at the design stage.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：光穩定性考量
blocks.en: Key Point: Photo Stability Considerations

blocks.zh: Photo Stability（光穩定性）：增加照明亮度以改善夜班工作表現是好主意，但必須評估光線對產品的影響。某些藥品（特別是生物製劑和某些小分子藥物）對光敏感，過強的照明可能導致降解。
blocks.en: Photo Stability: Increasing light levels to improve night-shift performance is a good idea, but the effect of the light on the product must be assessed. Some drugs (especially biologics and certain small-molecule drugs) are light-sensitive, and excessively intense lighting may cause degradation.

blocks.zh: 這是一個典型的 GMP 交叉考量：改善一個面向（人員效能）時，不能忽略另一個面向（產品品質）。
blocks.en: This is a typical GMP cross-consideration: when improving one aspect (personnel performance), you must not overlook another (product quality).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：預防性維護策略
blocks.en: Key Point: Preventive Maintenance Strategy

blocks.zh: 年度定期更換（Annual Replacement）：原文建議燈具可以每年定期更換，而不是等到故障再換。這是因為在潔淨室內更換燈具需要：
blocks.en: Annual Replacement: The source text suggests that light fixtures can be replaced on a scheduled annual basis instead of waiting for them to fail. This is because replacing a fixture inside a cleanroom requires:

blocks.zh: 停機或暫停生產
blocks.en: Shutting down or pausing production

blocks.zh: 可能需要維修人員更衣進入潔淨室
blocks.en: Possibly having maintenance staff gown up and enter the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 更換後需要清潔和環境恢復
blocks.en: Cleaning and environmental recovery after the replacement

blocks.zh: 計劃性維護比非計劃性維護的干擾小得多。使用 LED 燈具可以將更換週期延長到數年，大幅減少維護介入次數。
blocks.en: Planned maintenance is far less disruptive than unplanned maintenance. Using LED fixtures can extend the replacement cycle to several years, greatly reducing the number of maintenance interventions.

blocks.zh: 7.6 Hazardous Environments 7.6 危險環境
blocks.en: 7.6 Hazardous Environments

blocks.zh: 核心概念：防爆環境
blocks.en: Core Concept: Explosion-Protected Environments

blocks.zh: ATEX（防爆分類）：當潔淨室中使用含溶劑的製程（如某些注射劑的配液步驟使用乙醇），或處理可燃粉塵時，該區域可能需要進行防爆分類。
blocks.en: ATEX (explosion protection classification): When a cleanroom uses processes involving solvents (for example, ethanol in the compounding step of some injectables) or handles combustible dust, the area may require hazardous area classification.

blocks.zh: 但原文指出，在無菌設施中這種情況非常罕見，原因是：
blocks.en: However, the source text points out that in sterile facilities this is very rare, because:

blocks.zh: 潔淨室的高換氣次數（每小時 20-60 次以上）快速稀釋可燃蒸氣
blocks.en: The high air change rate in cleanrooms (20-60 or more per hour) quickly dilutes flammable vapors

blocks.zh: 環境監控系統持續偵測異常
blocks.en: The environmental monitoring system continuously detects abnormalities

blocks.zh: 然而，設計時必須考慮「如果 HVAC 風扇停止旋轉會怎樣？」— 這就是失效模式分析（Failure Mode Analysis）的範疇。
blocks.en: Even so, the design must consider "what happens if the HVAC fans stop rotating?" This falls within the scope of Failure Mode Analysis.

blocks.zh: 瓦斯爐 vs 通風廚房：在通風良好的廚房使用瓦斯爐，瓦斯洩漏的風險很低，因為空氣流通會稀釋任何洩漏。但如果抽油煙機壞了（相當於 HVAC 故障），瓦斯就可能累積到危險濃度。潔淨室的高換氣次數就是那台「超級抽油煙機」— 但你仍然需要考慮它故障時的情境。
blocks.en: Gas stove vs. ventilated kitchen: Using a gas stove in a well-ventilated kitchen carries very little risk of a gas leak, because air movement dilutes any leakage. But if the extractor hood breaks down (equivalent to an HVAC failure), the gas could build up to a dangerous concentration. The high air change rate of a cleanroom is that "super extractor hood", but you still need to consider the scenario in which it fails.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：靜電防護
blocks.en: Key Point: Static Protection

blocks.zh: 靜電累積（Static Build-up）在使用可燃溶劑或處理粉體的區域是嚴重的安全隱患。原文要求：
blocks.en: Static Build-up is a serious safety hazard in areas that use flammable solvents or handle powders. The source text requires:

blocks.zh: 安裝導電地板（Conductive Floors），將靜電導入地面
blocks.en: Installing Conductive Floors to carry static charge to ground

blocks.zh: 為人員、設備、物料提供靜電消散措施
blocks.en: Providing static dissipation measures for personnel, equipment and materials

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，如果承接含有有機溶劑的注射劑代工專案，這些防爆要求就必須納入設施設計。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, if you take on contract injectable projects involving organic solvents, these explosion-protection requirements must be built into the facility design.

blocks.zh: 7.7 Wiring 7.7 配線
blocks.en: 7.7 Wiring

blocks.zh: 核心概念：配線穿牆管理
blocks.en: Core Concept: Managing Wiring Penetrations

blocks.zh: 穿牆（Wiring Penetration）是潔淨室完整性的重大威脅。每一個穿過牆壁、天花板或地板的電線通道都是潛在的：
blocks.en: Wiring Penetration is a major threat to cleanroom integrity. Every cable pathway through a wall, ceiling or floor is a potential:

blocks.zh: 空氣洩漏點 — 破壞房間壓差
blocks.en: Air leakage point - undermining room pressure differentials

blocks.zh: 污染通道 — 外部微粒或微生物可能沿著管線進入
blocks.en: Contamination pathway - external particles or microorganisms may travel along the conduit

blocks.zh: 清潔死角 — 穿牆處難以徹底清潔
blocks.en: Cleaning blind spot - penetrations are difficult to clean thoroughly

blocks.zh: 因此，原文強調必須最小化穿牆數量，且所有穿牆處必須密封。
blocks.en: The source text therefore stresses that the number of penetrations must be minimized, and that all penetrations must be sealed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：看不見的污染庫
blocks.en: Key Point: The Unseen Contamination Reservoir

blocks.zh: 未密封線槽的隱藏風險：原文提出一個深刻的觀察 — 未密封的線槽（Trunking）表面看起來可能很乾淨，但內部實際上是污染物的儲存庫（Reservoir for Contaminants）。灰塵、微粒甚至微生物可以在線槽內部累積，然後隨著氣流緩慢釋放到潔淨室中。
blocks.en: The hidden risk of unsealed trunking: The source text makes a profound observation: unsealed trunking may look clean on the surface, but inside it is actually a Reservoir for Contaminants. Dust, particles and even microorganisms can accumulate inside the trunking and then be slowly released into the cleanroom by the airflow.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 ISPE 指南要求線槽必須完全密封 — 不只是「看起來密封」，而是真正能阻止空氣和微粒流通。
blocks.en: This is why the ISPE Guide requires trunking to be fully sealed: not just "looking sealed", but genuinely preventing the movement of air and particles.

blocks.zh: 水管漏水的比喻：想像你家的牆壁裡有一根生鏽的水管 — 表面看起來牆壁完好無損，但水管內部一直在漏水，慢慢侵蝕牆體。未密封的電線管道就是潔淨室裡的「隱形漏水管」— 外表完好，但持續讓不受控的空氣（和污染物）進出潔淨室。
blocks.en: The leaking pipe analogy: Imagine a rusty water pipe inside the wall of your home. The wall looks intact on the surface, but the pipe has been leaking all along, slowly eroding the wall. An unsealed cable conduit is the "invisible leaking pipe" of a cleanroom: it looks fine on the outside, but it keeps letting uncontrolled air (and contaminants) move in and out of the cleanroom.

blocks.zh: CDMO 配線最佳實務：
blocks.en: CDMO wiring best practices:

blocks.zh: 在設計階段就規劃所有穿牆位置，預留適當的管線通道
blocks.en: Plan all penetration locations at the design stage and reserve suitable cable routes

blocks.zh: 使用合格的穿牆密封系統（如 Roxtec 或同等品），每個穿牆點都要有壓力測試記錄
blocks.en: Use qualified penetration sealing systems (such as Roxtec or equivalent), with a pressure test record for every penetration point

blocks.zh: 移動設備的電纜使用天花板垂吊或捲線器，避免拖地造成清潔困難
blocks.en: Use ceiling-suspended cables or cable reels for mobile equipment, to avoid cables lying on the floor and making cleaning difficult

blocks.zh: 所有密封點納入定期檢查計畫，確保長期維持完整性
blocks.en: Include all sealing points in a periodic inspection program to maintain integrity over the long term

blocks.zh: 7.8 Door Interlocks 7.8 門互鎖
blocks.en: 7.8 Door Interlocks

blocks.zh: 核心概念：門連鎖系統
blocks.en: Core Concept: Door Interlock Systems

blocks.zh: 門連鎖 / 互鎖（Door Interlock）：確保氣閘（Airlock）的兩扇門不會同時打開的電氣控制機制。這是維持潔淨室壓差級聯的關鍵防線。
blocks.en: Door Interlock: An electrical control mechanism that ensures the two doors of an airlock cannot be open at the same time. It is a key line of defense in maintaining the cleanroom pressure cascade.

blocks.zh: 運作原理：
blocks.en: How it works:

blocks.zh: 當一扇門打開時，另一扇門被電氣鎖定，無法開啟
blocks.en: When one door is open, the other is electrically locked and cannot be opened

blocks.zh: 只有當第一扇門完全關閉後，第二扇門才能解鎖
blocks.en: The second door can be unlocked only after the first door is fully closed

blocks.zh: 如果兩扇門同時打開（故障情況），系統觸發警報
blocks.en: If both doors are open at the same time (a fault condition), the system triggers an alarm

blocks.zh: 銀行金庫的雙門設計：就像銀行金庫的入口 — 你必須先進入第一扇門，等它關閉後，第二扇門才會打開。這確保金庫不會直接暴露在外界環境中。潔淨室的氣閘互鎖設計邏輯完全相同 — 防止高潔淨度區域直接暴露在低潔淨度區域的空氣中。
blocks.en: The double doors of a bank vault: Like the entrance to a bank vault, you must first enter through the first door and wait for it to close before the second door will open. This ensures the vault is never directly exposed to the outside environment. The airlock interlock in a cleanroom follows exactly the same logic: it prevents a higher-grade area from being directly exposed to the air of a lower-grade area.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：緊急覆寫功能
blocks.en: Key Point: Emergency Override

blocks.zh: Override（覆寫 / 強制開啟）：原文特別強調，門互鎖系統必須包含緊急覆寫功能。這是人命安全（Life Safety）的基本要求 — 在火災、化學洩漏或其他緊急情況下，人員必須能夠快速撤離，不能被互鎖系統困住。
blocks.en: Override: The source text specifically stresses that a door interlock system must include an emergency override function. This is a basic Life Safety requirement: in a fire, chemical spill or other emergency, personnel must be able to evacuate quickly and must not be trapped by the interlock system.

blocks.zh: 這是一個典型的 GMP vs 安全 的權衡：正常情況下互鎖保護產品品質，緊急情況下人命安全優先。
blocks.en: This is a typical trade-off between GMP and safety: under normal conditions the interlock protects product quality, while in an emergency life safety takes priority.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：電子門禁
blocks.en: Key Point: Electronic Access Control

blocks.zh: 電子門禁控制（Electronic Access Control）在 ISO 5 無菌操作區域是必要的。目的是：
blocks.en: Electronic Access Control is necessary in ISO 5 aseptic operation areas. Its purposes are to:

blocks.zh: 限制只有經過培訓和更衣認證的人員才能進入
blocks.en: Restrict entry to personnel who have been trained and qualified in gowning

blocks.zh: 記錄進出人員和時間，提供可追溯性
blocks.en: Record who enters and when, providing traceability

blocks.zh: 防止未授權人員進入可能污染無菌環境
blocks.en: Prevent unauthorized persons from entering and potentially contaminating the sterile environment

blocks.zh: 門互鎖系統應在設施試車 / 確效（Commissioning / Qualification）階段進行驗證，確認其功能符合設計要求。
blocks.en: The door interlock system should be verified during the Commissioning / Qualification phase of the facility, to confirm that its function meets the design requirements.

blocks.zh: 7.9 Outlets and Miscellaneous Equipment 7.9 插座與其他設備
blocks.en: 7.9 Outlets and Miscellaneous Equipment

blocks.zh: 核心概念：雜項設備的 GMP 設計
blocks.en: Core Concept: GMP Design of Miscellaneous Equipment

blocks.zh: 潔淨室內除了照明和配電之外，還有許多「雜項」電氣設備需要符合 GMP 要求。原文列舉了幾個重要類別：
blocks.en: Besides lighting and power distribution, a cleanroom contains many "miscellaneous" items of electrical equipment that also need to meet GMP requirements. The source text lists several important categories:

blocks.zh: 消防偵測 — 吸入式偵煙（Aspirated Fire Detection）可以避免在潔淨室內安裝傳統煙霧偵測器
blocks.en: Fire detection - Aspirated Fire Detection avoids the need to install conventional smoke detectors inside the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 通訊系統 — 喇叭需要加裝密封膜，或改用無線通訊
blocks.en: Communication systems - speakers need a sealing membrane, or wireless communication can be used instead

blocks.zh: 蟲害防治 — 捕蟲燈（Insect Light Traps）放在潔淨室外圍
blocks.en: Pest control - Insect Light Traps are placed outside the cleanroom perimeter

blocks.zh: 排水控制 — ISO 8 區域水槽下方使用電加熱生物控制陷阱
blocks.en: Drainage control - electrically heated bio-control traps under sinks in ISO 8 areas

blocks.zh: 重點提示：吸入式偵煙系統
blocks.en: Key Point: Aspirated Smoke Detection Systems

blocks.zh: Aspirated Fire Detection（吸入式偵煙）：這是一種將空氣從被監控區域持續吸入到遠端偵測器的系統。它的優點在於：
blocks.en: Aspirated Fire Detection: A system that continuously draws air from the monitored area to a remote detector. Its advantages are:

blocks.zh: 潔淨室內無設備 — 偵測器主體安裝在技術區域，只有小型取樣管在潔淨室內
blocks.en: No equipment inside the cleanroom - the detector unit is installed in the technical area, and only small sampling pipes are inside the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 高靈敏度 — 可以在極早期偵測到煙霧
blocks.en: High sensitivity - smoke can be detected at a very early stage

blocks.zh: 避免誤報 — 傳統煙霧偵測器可能被 VHP 消毒的霧氣觸發
blocks.en: Avoids false alarms - conventional smoke detectors may be triggered by the vapor from VHP sanitization

blocks.zh: 在 ISO 5 區域，這幾乎是唯一可行的偵煙方案。
blocks.en: In ISO 5 areas, this is almost the only workable smoke detection solution.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：無菌區禁止排水
blocks.en: Key Point: No Drains in Sterile Areas

blocks.zh: ISO 5 和 ISO 7 區域不允許有水槽和排水口 — 這是 GMP 的基本原則。排水系統是微生物生長的溫床，直接威脅無菌環境。
blocks.en: Sinks and drains are not permitted in ISO 5 and ISO 7 areas: this is a basic GMP principle. Drainage systems are a breeding ground for microorganisms and a direct threat to the sterile environment.

blocks.zh: 但在 ISO 8/Grade C 區域，水槽是必要的（如手部清潔）。原文建議在水槽下方使用電加熱生物控制陷阱（Bio-control Trap） — 通過加熱來抑制排水管中的微生物生長，作為化學消毒的替代方案。
blocks.en: In ISO 8/Grade C areas, however, sinks are necessary (for example, for hand washing). The source text recommends using an electrically heated Bio-control Trap under the sink, which uses heat to suppress microbial growth in the drain pipe as an alternative to chemical disinfection.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室是「無聲手術室」：在手術室裡，你不會安裝普通的家用對講機 — 所有通訊設備都必須防水、可消毒、不釋放微粒。潔淨室的喇叭系統也是如此 — 加裝密封膜後，聲音可以穿透，但空氣和微粒不能。現代趨勢是使用可清潔的密封式無線通訊設備，完全消除牆壁上的開孔需求。
blocks.en: The cleanroom as a "silent operating room": In an operating room, you would not install an ordinary household intercom; all communication equipment must be waterproof, disinfectable and non-shedding. The same applies to cleanroom speaker systems: with a sealing membrane fitted, sound can pass through, but air and particles cannot. The modern trend is to use cleanable, sealed wireless communication devices, eliminating the need for openings in the wall altogether.

blocks.zh: CDMO 設施規劃清單：
blocks.en: CDMO facility planning checklist:

blocks.zh: ISO 5 區域：吸入式偵煙 + 閃燈警報（取代蜂鳴器） + 密封式通訊
blocks.en: ISO 5 areas: aspirated fire detection + flashing light alarms (in place of buzzers) + sealed communication

blocks.zh: ISO 7 區域：嵌入式消防偵測 + 密封喇叭膜 + 無排水設計
blocks.en: ISO 7 areas: recessed fire detection + sealed speaker membranes + no-drain design

blocks.zh: ISO 8 區域：標準偵煙（含防 VHP 誤報） + 電加熱排水陷阱 + 外圍捕蟲燈
blocks.en: ISO 8 areas: standard smoke detection (with protection against VHP false alarms) + electrically heated drain traps + insect light traps on the perimeter

blocks.zh: 所有區域：嵌入式或齊平安裝、可清潔材質、與消毒劑相容
blocks.en: All areas: recessed or flush mounting, cleanable materials, and compatibility with sanitization agents

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本章重點回顧
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: General Requirements / 一般要求：All electrical equipment in aseptic areas must be cleanable, ledge-free, non-shedding, sealed, and compatible with sanitization agents. ISO 5 areas require hermetic sealing and absolute minimization of installed equipment / 無菌區域所有電氣設備必須可清潔、無凸緣、不脫落、密封、與消毒劑相容。ISO 5 區域要求氣密封和最小化安裝量
blocks.en: General Requirements: All electrical equipment in aseptic areas must be cleanable, ledge-free, non-shedding, sealed, and compatible with sanitization agents. ISO 5 areas require hermetic sealing and absolute minimization of installed equipment

blocks.zh: Control System Power / 控制系統電力：UPS is essential for digital control systems (BMS, SCADA, PLC) to ensure orderly shutdown and data integrity during power loss. Staggered restart programming prevents breaker trips / UPS 對數位控制系統不可或缺，確保斷電時有序關機與數據完整性。依序重啟程式防止跳閘
blocks.en: Control System Power: UPS is essential for digital control systems (BMS, SCADA, PLC) to ensure orderly shutdown and data integrity during power loss. Staggered restart programming prevents breaker trips

blocks.zh: Power Distribution / 配電系統：DP monitoring power is critical — loss of pressure monitoring during outages directly impacts product quality assessment. Power quality (harmonics, phase balance) matters for precision equipment / 差壓監控的供電至關重要。電力品質（諧波、相位平衡）影響精密設備運作
blocks.en: Power Distribution: DP monitoring power is critical — loss of pressure monitoring during outages directly impacts product quality assessment. Power quality (harmonics, phase balance) matters for precision equipment

blocks.zh: Lighting / 照明：Minimum 500 lux at work areas. Flush-mount (recess) fixtures mandatory in ISO 5 to avoid airflow disruption. LED preferred for reduced maintenance. Consider photo stability impact on light-sensitive products / 工作區最低 500 lux。ISO 5 區域必須使用嵌入式燈具以避免干擾氣流。LED 首選以減少維護。須考慮光穩定性影響
blocks.en: Lighting: Minimum 500 lux at work areas. Flush-mount (recess) fixtures mandatory in ISO 5 to avoid airflow disruption. LED preferred for reduced maintenance. Consider photo stability impact on light-sensitive products

blocks.zh: Hazardous Environments / 防爆環境：ATEX classification is rare in sterile facilities due to high air changes, but failure mode analysis (HVAC loss) is required. Static dissipation and conductive floors may be needed / 無菌設施中防爆分類較罕見，但需進行失效模式分析。可能需要靜電消散和導電地板
blocks.en: Hazardous Environments: ATEX classification is rare in sterile facilities due to high air changes, but failure mode analysis (HVAC loss) is required. Static dissipation and conductive floors may be needed

blocks.zh: Wiring / 配線：Minimize wall/ceiling penetrations, seal all conduits. Unsealed trunking is a hidden contamination reservoir. Mobile equipment cables must be kept off the floor / 最小化穿牆數量，密封所有管線。未密封線槽是隱藏的污染庫。移動設備電纜不可拖地
blocks.en: Wiring: Minimize wall/ceiling penetrations, seal all conduits. Unsealed trunking is a hidden contamination reservoir. Mobile equipment cables must be kept off the floor

blocks.zh: Door Interlocks / 門連鎖：Airlock interlocks maintain pressure cascades. Emergency override is mandatory for life safety. Electronic access control required for ISO 5 areas. Verify during commissioning/qualification / 氣閘互鎖維持壓差級聯。緊急覆寫功能為強制要求。ISO 5 區域需電子門禁。試車確效時需驗證
blocks.en: Door Interlocks: Airlock interlocks maintain pressure cascades. Emergency override is mandatory for life safety. Electronic access control required for ISO 5 areas. Verify during commissioning/qualification

blocks.zh: Miscellaneous / 雜項設備：Aspirated fire detection for ISO 5 (avoids in-room equipment). Sealed communication membranes. Insect traps outside cleanrooms. Bio-control heated traps for ISO 8 drains / ISO 5 使用吸入式偵煙。通訊系統加密封膜。捕蟲燈設於潔淨室外。ISO 8 排水使用電加熱生物控制陷阱
blocks.en: Miscellaneous: Aspirated fire detection for ISO 5 (avoids in-room equipment). Sealed communication membranes. Insect traps outside cleanrooms. Bio-control heated traps for ISO 8 drains
